energy_cascade_analogy.market_cascade: volatility cascade: large-scale vol shocks fragment into small-scale intermittent bursts (multifractal)
energy_cascade_analogy.fluid_cascade: Kolmogorov energy cascade: energy injected at large eddies dissipated at the Kolmogorov microscale
references: Ghashghaie et al. (Nature, 1996) Turbulent cascades in foreign exchange markets
Gatheral, Jaisson, Rosenbaum (2018) Volatility is rough (H~=0.1)

interpretation: The classic Lorenz set has a positive largest Lyapunov exponent and no stable fixed point: a strange attractor, classified turbulent.
This is an analogue lens for Navier-Stokes turbulence; it characterizes a regime and does not address existence or smoothness.
